question: Can I reach you at 2am?
html:
We can't yet confirm that a live person answers at 2am. The data we hold doesn't record Punctual Pros' overnight phone coverage, so the honest answer is "not verified." Here is what we do know about late-night calls.

What the data shows

  • After-hours calls are a real share of demand. ServiceTitan data show off-hours calls at 14.1% of HVAC inbound in June, versus 9.8% in October 2025 (Punctual Pros demand model).
  • Most off-hours calls come early, not at 2am. The off-hours peak is 5 to 9 pm local time (Punctual Pros demand model).
  • Trades lose 30-40% of off-hours calls (Voice AI research).
  • Across home services, only 52% of callers reach a person (Invoca benchmark, published Jul 2026, via Voice AI research).
MeasureValueSource
Assumed after-hours share of calls12% (est.)Voice AI research
Assumed after-hours calls lost35% (est.)Voice AI research
Overall missed-call share14.8% (est.)Voice AI research

These figures are model assumptions for Punctual Pros, not measured results.

What we don't know

  • Punctual Pros' actual call volume and missed-call rate are not public (Voice AI research).
  • Nothing in our data states hours of live answering, on-call technicians or overnight dispatch.
  • Hourly call logs from the phone system or ServiceTitan would answer this. They would show calls by hour, answer rate and booking rate after midnight.

Where AI answering fits

  • AI voice agents can answer every call and book the job. Vendors report booking rates of 70% overall and 90% when capacity is open (ServiceTitan, via Voice AI research).
  • The typical human CSR books 42% of calls (Voice AI research).
  • Vendor outcome numbers are self-reported and unaudited. Treat them as ranges (Voice AI research).

An unanswered 2am call is a buyer with an urgent problem who will call the next number on Google, and the Voice AI research puts the recoverable after-hours piece at about $390,000 a year (est.) for this portfolio company.

Next actions

  1. Confirm current overnight coverage, such as an answering service, an on-call rotation or voicemail. Then publish the confirmed hours on the site.
  2. Pull 12 months of hourly call logs from ServiceTitan. Measure the after-hours answer and booking rates and replace the 12% and 35% assumptions.
  3. Pilot an AI voice agent on overnight and overflow calls. Track booked jobs against the growth plan's after-hours target.
  4. Test a callback within 5 minutes for any missed call. Leads contacted within 5 minutes are 21 times more likely to qualify than leads contacted at 30 minutes (MIT/InsideSales, via Voice AI research).
